issues.issue: Unexplained local receipts are 56.5% of the year's receipts (43,236.22 of 76,520.33). They recur (34,729.74 prior year, 40,000 budgeted), so they are probably not loan proceeds, but nothing on the form says what they are. 'other' with review follows the rules; the governmental 'other' share is far above 10%.

issues.on_page: TOTAL ALL FUNDS (budget form, tax-levying hospital district)
issues.issue: entity_type is 'hospital', and the extractor rules treat hospitals as entirely business-type. This is a tax-levying district filing a cash-basis budget form (General Fund levy only), so governmental is defensible. It does not match the hospital rule, though, and affects every line and the top-level balances.
